reel_formats.name: This is your sign
reel_formats.how: B-roll from camera roll with on-screen text pointing at the 'sign' + call-to-action
reel_formats.adapt: Salon/physio: 'This is your sign to book that appointment' or 'This is your sign to redesign your online presence'

reel_formats.name: Two Friends, Two Vibes
reel_formats.how: Show two different personalities or approaches working together seamlessly
reel_formats.adapt: Barber team dynamics or web designer collaborating with salon owner on booking system

reel_formats.name: Low-production founder content
reel_formats.how: Clear opinions, proof from your work, phone-shot quality, answers instead of announcements
reel_formats.adapt: Salon owner sharing '5 booking mistakes I made' or 'why I switched to online booking'

reel_formats.name: Short-form Q&A Reels
reel_formats.how: Answer a searched question in 15-30 seconds with searchable captions
reel_formats.adapt: Physio: 'How long does a first appointment take?' or salon: 'What should I wear to my first cut?'

carousel_formats.name: Unfortunately I Do Love...
carousel_formats.why: Admitting things you love (even if embarrassing) builds relatability and personality
carousel_formats.adapt: Salon owner: 'Unfortunately I do love Instagram trends' → carousel selling reels service

carousel_formats.name: My Recent Flops
carousel_formats.why: Sharing failures humanizes and drives saves; builds trust for coaching/services
carousel_formats.adapt: Web designer or salon: 'Website redesigns that flopped (and how I fixed them)'

carousel_formats.name: 5 Things I Don't Do
carousel_formats.why: Text-based carousel setting clear boundaries or philosophy; high save rate
carousel_formats.adapt: Salon: '5 trends I don't follow' or web designer: '5 things I don't do in UX'

platform_news.item: Instagram replaces Q&A with Ask Maps (AI-powered)
platform_news.impact: Business profiles: update FAQs; Google Business Profile now auto-answers questions, so ensure your profile data is rich and current

platform_news.item: Google Business Profile: 30-day freshness signal enforced
platform_news.impact: Post monthly updates, reply to reviews same-week. Inactive profiles drop in local search.

platform_news.item: Meta launches Muse for Small Business (Sept 29, 2026)
platform_news.impact: AI agent connecting Asana, Zoom, Slack, Canva, Meta ads. Swiss salon/physio owners: use for scheduling + social management automation

platform_news.item: Google AI scans menus/PDFs and formats them into digital layouts
platform_news.impact: Service-based businesses: document your booking process, services, pricing in photos; Google auto-extracts and displays

industry_hooks.topic: Carousel posts outperform Reels on saves and shares
industry_hooks.angle: Small business owners avoid video production anxiety: carousels = higher engagement for service proof (before-afters, client stories)
Salon/physio owner: post raw, founder-led content. Success ≠ likes; measure via saves, DMs, and bookings

industry_hooks.topic: Local.ch is Switzerland's #1 booking platform (500k+ profiles)
industry_hooks.angle: Swiss beauty/physio/trades: if you're not on local.ch or linked to Meta Muse, competitors are capturing your online booking traffic

industry_hooks.topic: AI in Swiss business: 83% of retailers use AI (2026)
industry_hooks.angle: Web designer pitch: AI isn't optional. Build clients' booking bots, email automation, social content drafts.
